status: candidate static optical layout; not a calibrated or collision-qualified installation

cameras.name: C1 · Pickup overview
cameras.purpose: Locate loose cable and board; observe pickup approach. Not final insertion metrology.

cameras.name: C2 · End presentation
cameras.purpose: Inspect a deliberately presented cable end before approaching the board. Reorient to inspect its other face.

cameras.name: C3 · Entrance / west offset
cameras.purpose: Entrance-facing view at about 11 degrees from the board normal; complement with side view.

cameras.name: C4 · CSI east view
cameras.purpose: Opposite-face observation when the cable or jaw hides features from C3.

limitations: Lens near-focus range is unverified; stored focus distances are assumptions, not hardware capability.
Depth of field, distortion, Bayer/ISP, noise, rolling scan and transport latency are not calibrated or simulated.
Published 41 degree HFOV differs from the nominal focal-length/pixel-pitch pinhole estimate; real calibration must resolve this.
15 fps specifies the reference hardware mode, not achieved rendering or control frequency.
Static authored cable and jaw probes, not qualified grasp/contact physics.

inspection_lighting.scope: authored matte backdrop and diffuse area light, not calibrated radiometry; fixture clearance unqualified
